subject: PSOX SOC2 - Authorization artifacts & SSO/SCIM timeline
messages:
From: Avery Reed <security@psox.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: Psox Health Security Team <security@psox.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2026 11:22:00 -0400
Subject: SOC2 / SIG - Request: SSO, SCIM & RBAC artifacts

Hi Diego,

We're starting the PSOX SOC2 readiness intake and need a focused set of artifacts to validate your authorization controls and provisioning flow. Can you share the following for a sampling window (Feb 1 2026 - Apr 30 2026):

- SSO configuration details (SAML metadata, IdP/ACS endpoints) and 2–3 anonymized SAML assertion samples showing typical attributes.
- SCIM delta logs for the sampling window (created/updated/deprovision events).
- A role-owner matrix (who owns each role/service account) and the process you use to assign/remove owners.
- Short narrative (1–2 paragraphs) on least-privilege enforcement (role design, periodic reviews, automation).
- Any recent change-control records for provisioning changes during the window.

We prefer secure upload (Link or DocuSign/Drive link). If anything contains PII we will provide a secure S3 bucket and an ITR. Target timeline: we would like artifacts by EOD Wed May 12 to stay on the SOC2 schedule.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that helps triage what to provide.

Best,
Avery Reed
Security Engineer, Psox Health
[Attachment: PSOX-SOC2-ASKS.pdf (PDF, 40KB)]

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 7 May 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SOC2 / SIG - Request: SSO, SCIM & RBAC artifacts

Forwarding PSOX ask — they need a compact artifact bundle by EOD Wed May 12. Laura, can you take SSO/SAML samples and the narrative on least-privilege? Markus, can you pull SCIM delta exports for Feb–Apr and flag any PII redaction needs. Vivek, please assemble role-owner matrix and any recent provisioning change logs (PRs, runbook updates).

Notes:
- Keep the bundle minimal and redact user-identifying fields where possible; we can provide an S3 upload if the files are large.
- If any artifacts require legal/marketing sign-off (contracts or vendor notices), flag now — do not delay the delivery.

I will send a reply to Avery once we have links. If anyone can't hit May 12, call it out and propose the earliest reasonable date.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: forwarded-request.eml (EML)]

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC2 / SIG - Request: SSO, SCIM & RBAC artifacts

Diego — taking point on the SSO side. Quick plan:

1) SAML metadata & config notes: I will export the IdP metadata and compose a 1-page config summary (endpoints, cert rotation cadence).

2) Assertion samples: I'll generate 3 anonymized assertion examples (strip user IDs, replace with stable pseudonyms) and attach as PDF.

3) Least-privilege narrative: 3 short bullets plus a one-paragraph summary on our role hierarchy and periodic review cadence.

About SCIM logs / redaction: Markus, please confirm whether the delta export contains email addresses; if so we'll use the secure S3 approach. If not, we can attach CSV directly.

Deliverables I'm preparing now: saml-assertion-samples.pdf, role-owner-matrix.xlsx (template with owners filled), and a short summary doc. Expect initial upload by 16:00 PT today. If anything else is needed for SIG/CAIQ mapping, call it out.

Laura Bennett
Security & Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: saml-config-notes.txt (TXT, 2KB)]

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Avery Reed <security@psox.com>
Cc: Psox Health Security Team <security@psox.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 May 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: SOC2 / SIG - Request: SSO, SCIM & RBAC artifacts

Avery — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Attached are the artifacts we can share immediately and links for larger exports:

Attachments (attached to this message):
- saml-assertion-samples.pdf (anonymized examples)
- role-owner-matrix.xlsx (owners for platform roles)
- scim-delta-log-2026Q1.csv (trimmed and pseudonymized; full export available via secure link)

Secure upload for large logs: https://drive.redwood.internal/PSOX/iam-artifacts (internal link; we will provide an S3 upload if you need external access)

Short sampling notes:
- SCIM export was filtered to include CRUD events from 2026-02-01 to 2026-04-30; email addresses were pseudonymized and high-risk fields redacted.
- Role-owner matrix maps roles to named custodians and includes the last-reviewed date.
- Our least-privilege approach: roles are narrowly scoped by service surface, automated onboarding assigns scoped roles via SCIM groups, and we require quarterly owner attestations; see the attached short summary for details.

If you'd like a signed attestation or a short walkthrough call, we can schedule that this week — I have availability Tue/Wed morning PT.

Best regards,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachments: saml-assertion-samples.pdf, scim-delta-log-2026Q1.csv, role-owner-matrix.xlsx]
